description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for four configurations (small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8). The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25 to 42.5 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2.5 units. The “small AdaLoRA_int4” series is drawn as a solid line with circular markers and decreases from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 34.7 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 32.9 (epoch 3), 32.1 (epoch 4), and 31.3 (epoch 5). The “small AdaLoRA_int8” series is a solid line with square markers and declines from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 25.0 at epoch 6, with intermediate values near 29.8 (epoch 1), 28.6 (epoch 2), 28.1 (epoch 3), 27.3 (epoch 4), and 26.5 (epoch 5). The “small int4” series is a dashed line with circular markers that rises from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to a peak near 42.2 at epoch 2, then falls to about 31.5 by epoch 6, with values around 40.1 (epoch 1), 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.3 (epoch 4), and 34.0 (epoch 5). The “small int8” series is a dashed line with square markers that increases from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 33.8 at epoch 2, then drops to about 29.4 at epoch 3 and continues downward to about 25.4 at epoch 5 before ending near 26.0 at epoch 6.
